## 5. Retrieval metadata (design)

Proposed fields on each indexed document (or sidecar JSON keyed by `CARD_ID`):

- `rag_scope`: `INTRADAY_ADVISER`  
- `execution_direction`: `LONG_ONLY`  
- `market_state[]`, `setup_family[]`, `decision_stage`, `directional_context`  
- `role`, `intraday_compatibility`, `risk_context`, `position_state[]`  
- `adviser_class` (from policy above)

Example wake **POSSIBLE_SECOND_ENTRY**, **TRADING_RANGE**, **FLAT** → pull 3–6 cards: `second_entry`, `signal_bar_quality`, `failed_second_entries`, `trading_range` entry quality, `trapped_traders`.

## 6. Search / indexing options

| Option | Retrieval | Effort | One-time compute | Ongoing | Indexing | Serving | Audit |
|--------|-----------|--------|------------------|---------|----------|---------|-------|
| **A — New Cortex service `INTRADAY_ADVISER`** | Best semantic + filters | High DDL + pipeline | Build corpus + index once | Low if index suspended | Yes | Cortex WH on query | Strong |
| **B — Card table + SQL/keyword only** | Moderate | Low | None | Minimal | No | Warehouse only | Good |
| **C — Hybrid metadata + Cortex (recommended)** | Best practical | Medium | One-time index ~1.1k filtered cards | Low event-driven queries | Yes, static | Same as A | Strong |

**Recommendation:** **Option C** — filter `ADVISER_CORE` + `BEARISH_CONTEXT_FOR_LONGS` + `LONG_MANAGEMENT` (~1,119 cards before manual review), exclude `SHORT_EXECUTION_EXCLUDE`, index once into `RAG_SCOPE=INTRADAY_ADVISER`, keep REVALIDATION service read-only for committee use. Do **not** index until manual class review on THIN topics (H2, II, IOI, EOD).

## 7. AMZN 2026-07-13 wake walkthrough (design proxies)

| Wake (design) | Market question | Topics | Library support |
|---------------|-----------------|--------|-----------------|
| Session open / gap context | Gap or trend from open? | gaps, opening_range, always_in | **ADEQUATE** (many gap/open cards; few pure OR) |
| First pullback / H1 | Is first pullback buyable? | h1, two_legged_pullback | **STRONG** |
| **Possible H2 / second entry** | Valid second entry long? | h2, second_entry, signal_bar | **THIN on H2 label** — rely on second_entry + two_legged (STRONG) |
| Breakout / follow-through | Breakout holding? | breakouts, follow_through | **STRONG** |
| Resistance / do-not-chase | Room to resistance? | support_resistance, trapped_traders, bearish context | **STRONG** |
| Entry / stop | Long entry + stop placement | entry_bar, stop_management (long) | **STRONG** (filter short-stop excludes) |
| Exit / end of session | Hold or exit into close? | late_session_eod, trade_management | **THIN** — needs manual EOD cards or broader “close” review |

## Gaps before Adviser implementation

1. **Human review** — 1,469 cards unreviewed; only 10 RAG-approved.  
2. **H2 / II / IOI / EOD** — keyword coverage THIN; add concept aliases or manual tags.  
3. **Short-exclude precision** — 145 auto-excluded; spot-check bear-context cards (e.g. “Low 2 Short Setup”) kept as context-only, not action.  
4. **Metadata schema** — map `CONCEPT_FAMILY` → `setup_family` + `decision_stage`.  
5. **No index build yet** — per project boundary.
